questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Template-Driven Forms”?
options: Template-Driven Forms should be implemented by copying a snippet without checking the Angular version.
Template-Driven Forms helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
Template-Driven Forms means the browser can enforce all permissions without the backend.
Template-Driven Forms removes the need for error handling, accessibility checks and tests.
questions.answer_key: Template-Driven Forms helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.explanation: Template-Driven Forms is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

questions.prompt: How should a learner work with “Setting up FormsModule” in this lesson?
options: Connect “Setting up FormsModule” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
Treat “Setting up FormsModule” as a reason to skip the surrounding application context.
Assume “Setting up FormsModule” works identically across every Angular major and runtime.
Use “Setting up FormsModule” to bypass runtime validation of external or user-provided values.
questions.answer_key: Connect “Setting up FormsModule” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.explanation: The PDF explicitly lists “Setting up FormsModule” under Template-Driven Forms. Anchor it in a small example and check the behavior rather than relying on a memorized phrase.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “Template-Driven Forms”?
options: Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
Treat a successful client-side render as backend authorization evidence.
Ignore a failing test if the component looks correct in one browser.
Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.answer_key: Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.explanation: Verification evidence should match the running environment. Static teaching snippets are not compiler output, and frontend checks do not replace backend authorization.
